accepted_findings: H1 v1 cannot represent native-only unresolved evidence without a false canonical subtype or a prose-only fact.
status_type=suspension is forbidden for unresolved SuspensionOfTrading=Ｙ.
partial with items=[] is structurally legal but has no structured native fact slot.
No existing Result -> Audit -> AI handoff path safely carries the native-only evidence.
H1 v1 remains unchanged; native_observations[] is the preferred sibling outside items[].
A2.0-R2 deferred Result V3 versus Result V4 selection to this design gate.

decision_basis.reason: The current Result V3 path has explicit later Phase I additive authority. An H1 v1-or-v2 oneOf is a narrow nested evidence-family extension with a schema_version const discriminator; it preserves the existing H1 v1 branch and does not change unrelated Result fields. Repository strict consumers are updateable behind the existing six MCP tools. No current rule requires a new outer Result major version for this nested additive extension.
decision_basis.historical_freeze_boundary: The H0-G manifest and its 2026-09-21 snapshot hashes remain immutable historical evidence. They do not prohibit later additive evolution under bounded current authority.
decision_basis.version_choice_scope: Design decision only. No Result V3 schema, H1 schema, runtime, route, or preferred-version promotion changed in A2.1A.

h1_v2_candidate.shape: Mirror H1 v1 fields and semantics, plus a required native_observations array outside canonical items. Keep one top-level source per artifact and preserve all v1 fields/behavior in the v1 branch.

native_observation_fields.source_native_value: required JSON scalar; preserve its JSON type and value
native_observation_fields.citation_ids: required non-empty unique citation ID array

semantic_invariants: An unresolved native observation never adds a canonical status_type to covered_status_types.
An unresolved observation requires a non-empty caveat, citation IDs and source_record_date.
No canonical status_lifecycle is required for a native observation.
No-evidence-in-covered-scope is invalid when a native observation exists.
The exact JSON scalar type is preserved; do not stringify non-string values.
An unresolved SuspensionOfTrading marker does not justify status_type=suspension or a stopped/tradeable conclusion.
h1_v2_candidate.semantic_status_vocabulary_decision: Use only unresolved for this native-observation contract. Do not add speculative source_defined or other future states; a later authoritative semantic mapping can produce a canonical item under a separately governed rule.

h1_v1_compatibility.existing_attention_route: Continues to emit H1 v1 unless separately authorized migration changes it.
h1_v1_compatibility.persisted_v1_artifacts: Remain unchanged and valid under the H1 v1 branch; no retroactive rewrite.

native_only_status_and_coverage.source_contract_validated: true only for payload/field/type/date grammar; it does not assert marker business semantics

source_and_composition_cardinality.h1_v1_source_model: One top-level source object per H1 artifact.
source_and_composition_cardinality.current_result_cardinality: Result V3 has one trading_status_context object per target; TargetEvidenceProjection also has a single dict field.
source_and_composition_cardinality.current_lineage_cardinality: One operation binding per (canonical_target_id, data_need); duplicate_binding is rejected, and multiple typed H1 artifacts for one binding raise duplicate_phase_h_typed_artifact.
source_and_composition_cardinality.h1_v2_recommendation: Keep one source contract per H1 artifact. Mixed canonical items and native observations may coexist only when they are supported by that same top-level source and each canonical item is independently semantically established and covered. Do not combine attention from source A with tpex_cmode native evidence from source B in one single-source H1 artifact.
source_and_composition_cardinality.representative_j_b03_implication: Current architecture does not aggregate separate attention, disposition and tpex_cmode operations for the same target/data_need into one Result field. A2.1B must preserve this boundary and explicitly determine how representative evidence from multiple source contracts is composed or separately surfaced; do not imply that selecting additive Result V3 solves source aggregation. This is an orthogonal composition design issue, not a Result V3 versus V4 incompatibility.
source_and_composition_cardinality.mixed_native_and_canonical_safety: A mixed artifact is structurally useful only for one source. Each canonical item's status_type must be covered and supported by governed semantics; the unresolved tpex_cmode marker itself cannot supply suspension coverage.

result_v3_additive_candidate.candidate_shape: Keep the Result V3 trading_status_context property and change its referenced definition to oneOf the unchanged H1 v1 definition and the new H1 v2 definition. The schema_version const makes the branches disjoint.
result_v3_additive_candidate.existing_v3_validity: All existing documents valid under the current H1 v1 branch remain valid; current Result V3 fixtures passed the in-memory candidate schema.
result_v3_additive_candidate.persisted_artifact_policy: Existing Result V3 artifacts remain byte-unchanged; readback validates the stored Result version and no artifact migration is required.
result_v3_additive_candidate.public_surface: No MCP input schema or tool-count change; update internal validators, maps, projectors and handoff consumers before emitting H1 v2.
result_v3_additive_candidate.unrelated_families: The proposed oneOf changes only the trading_status_context property. Other Phase G/H/I evidence definitions remain untouched.
result_v3_additive_candidate.current_authority: A2.1B must create a new dated/current acceptance record with the new Result V3 path hash and validator/projection/handoff acceptance evidence; the H0-G manifest remains unchanged.
result_v3_additive_candidate.rollback: The current preferred Result version remains server-owned. Rollback to V2 affects new materialization; persisted V3 packages remain read by their stored version. H1 v2 must fail closed when an authority/version path does not support it.

result_v3_additive_gate.old_result_v3_documents_remain_schema_va: PASS: preserve the current H1 v1 schema branch verbatim in the disjoint oneOf.
result_v3_additive_gate.persisted_artifacts_never_rewritten: PASS: stored package bytes/hashes remain immutable and are loaded by stored outer schema version.
result_v3_additive_gate.h1_v1_unchanged: PASS: no H1 v1 schema or artifact mutation.
result_v3_additive_gate.strict_consumers_update_without_public_m: PASS_WITH_A2_1B_UPDATES: all repository consumers are mutable/updateable; read/export tools retain their control-package input and six-tool surface. No frozen external strict response-schema consumer is declared in repository authority; any supported external consumer compatibility must be tested before release.
result_v3_additive_gate.existing_result_v3_semantics_unchanged: PASS: only the nested trading_status_context accepted shape is extended; existing fields retain their definitions.
result_v3_additive_gate.unrelated_evidence_families_unchanged: PASS: additive schema edit is limited to the H1 definition.
result_v3_additive_gate.rollback_and_current_authority_understan: PASS_WITH_TEST: current server-owned preferred version and stored-version readback are distinct; exercise additive V3 acceptance and V3-to-V2 rollback in A2.1B.
result_v3_additive_gate.new_dated_authority_can_freeze_new_hash: PASS: current V3 validator already separates immutable H0-G entries from mutable current V3 hashes.
result_v3_additive_gate.new_outer_major_version_explicitly_requi: NO: Phase I I0 explicitly left the exact Request/Result V3 additive schema shape for later bounded decisions and requires additive changes to preserve compatibility.
result_v3_additive_gate.overall: PASS; select additive Result V3 for the native H1 v2 union, subject to the A2.1B strict-consumer and rollback acceptance gates.

result_v4_candidate.compatibility_assessment: Viable alternative, but no concrete current incompatibility requires it. It would require new outer schema/version registration, result and audit path/version dispatch, persistence/readback coverage and consumer support.
select_only_if: Strict repository or supported external consumers cannot safely accept a Result V3 schema update.
A current Result V3 semantic guarantee is found to pin trading_status_context to H1 v1.
Current versioning governance requires a new outer version for this nested contract expansion.
The v1/v2 union cannot be made disjoint or persisted V3 readback becomes ambiguous.
result_v4_candidate.not_required_solely_because: The historical 2026-09-21 H0-G manifest records an earlier snapshot.

Current H1 operation artifact and Result assertion use v1; add v2-compatible operation and projection fixtures.
Protects primary artifact item_count and operation result aggregation invariants; native count support must be explicit and tested.

audit_v3.implementation_scope: Audit builder/loader/maps must recognize H1 v2 and its source attempts/citations; this does not require changing the Audit V3 schema.

ai_handoff.interpretation_guard: Never render SuspensionOfTrading=Ｙ as stopped, suspended or cannot trade without independent governed evidence.

count_semantics.canonical_status_item_count: len(items); retain current item_count meaning for canonical status items.
count_semantics.operation_result_evidence_count: Future explicit operation-level evidence count that accounts for canonical and native evidence without silently redefining legacy result_item_count or total_item_count.
count_semantics.recommendation: Keep item_count canonical-only and add native_observation_count. Define operation_result_evidence_count separately in the operation/bundle contract. Existing aggregation sums primary artifact item_count into result_item_count and total_item_count; do not overload those fields or simply sum arrays until a separately versioned aggregation rule and compatibility tests establish the semantics.

future_semantic_validator_invariants: Every canonical item.status_type must occur in coverage.covered_status_types, unless a separately accepted contract rule explicitly permits otherwise.
An unresolved native observation cannot add its corresponding canonical subtype to covered_status_types.
An unresolved SuspensionOfTrading=Ｙ observation cannot stand in for a canonical suspension item.
A native observation requires source_record_date, non-empty citation_ids and non-empty semantic_caveat.
No status_lifecycle is required for native observations.
Exact source JSON scalar value and scalar type must be preserved.
